description: HHI over Livepeer orchestrators (transcoders) by totalStake (self-bond + delegated stake). Bloc-voting model: delegators bond LPT to orchestrators who vote aggregate stake via BondingManager. Decision A4.
data_source: Livepeer Protocol subgraph on The Graph decentralized network (gateway.thegraph.com), subgraph id FE63YgkzcpVocxdCEyEYbvjYqEf2kb1A6daMYRxmejYC; credentials extracted from the live explorer.livepeer.org production build (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUBGRAPH_API_KEY embedded in client bundle).
query: { transcoders(first:1000, orderBy: id, orderDirection: asc){ id totalStake active status } } (id-cursor paginated)
totalStake_units: LPT (subgraph applies 18-decimal scaling; values are decimal LPT, not wei)
comparison: Orchestrator-level (bloc-voting) HHI ~0.0535 is MEANINGFULLY LOWER than raw token-holder HHI 0.198868 (approx 3.7x lower / less concentrated). Delegation of bonded stake across ~100 active orchestrators disperses voting concentration relative to the raw token distribution.
caveats: totalStake is the live subgraph-maintained current bonded stake per orchestrator (self-bond + delegated); NO event-replay approximation needed (Route 1 succeeded; Routes 2/3 not required).

Active set = orchestrators in the active rotation (active:true, status Registered). Inactive-but-bonded orchestrators (NotRegistered with residual bonded stake) hold 1.108% of bonded LPT; including them moves HHI only from 0.053521 to 0.052374.

HHI computed over orchestrator total-stake shares, NOT over individual delegators. A single large delegator concentrated under one orchestrator is captured at the orchestrator bloc level, consistent with the BondingManager bloc-voting governance model.
Credentials are a public NEXT_PUBLIC_ client-side key shipped in the explorer bundle (rate-limited gateway access), not a private secret.
